capabilities.justification: Reads required_capabilities.json manifests and Rust source files during package analysis.
Recursively discovers Rust source files within the target package directory.
Creates target source directories when generating capability modules.
Emits generated capability modules and canonical effect proof certificates to target package directory.
Emits capability analysis reports and diagnostics to standard output.
Reads CLI arguments via std::env::args during invocation.
Exits with status codes via std::process::exit on success or failure.

justification: Static analysis CLI tool that reads package files, checks capabilities, and prints analysis reports.
